entries.acceptanceRationale: A genuine edge case, recorded deliberately. The host channel is third-party, but the educator SPEAKS IN IT -- so his own statements are primary even though the publisher is not. Attribution would need to be scoped to his speech only, with the interviewer's words excluded, and the provenance record must show publisher != educator.
entries.confidenceBasis: Interview format is discursive and may never reach mechanics. Title is performance-claim framed, which correlates with MARKETING_DOMINANT content in this library.
governanceNote: Ingesting this would require a convention for 'educator speech on a third-party channel' that the evidence schema does not currently express. Flagged, not assumed.
